Actual Article Body:
The Department of Education rescinded the Biden administration’s 2024 interpretation of Title IX that protected students from sex-based discrimination on the basis of their sexual orientation and gender identity.

Education Secretary Linda McMahon announced the move on Monday after a federal judge struck down the Biden-era regulations last year.
